notice: SAMPLE DATA for the ScholarPath MVP. Names refer to real, well-known programs, but deadlines, amounts and rules are simplified and may be outdated. Always verify on the provider's site.

opportunities.name: DAAD EPOS Development-Related Postgraduate Scholarship
opportunities.deadline: Varies by course, typically August to October
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full funding: tuition, monthly stipend, travel
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Graduates from developing countries with 2+ years of professional experience
opportunities.description: Funds master's and PhD study in Germany in development-related fields such as public health, engineering, economics, environment and data science.

opportunities.name: MSc Informatics
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Tuition about $6,500 per semester for non-EU students
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Bachelor's in computer science or closely related field
opportunities.description: Research-oriented master's in computer science with specializations in machine learning, artificial intelligence, robotics and software engineering.

opportunities.name: Vector Scholarship in Artificial Intelligence
opportunities.cost_or_funding: About $17,500 CAD for the first year of an AI master's in Ontario
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants to recognized AI master's programs at Ontario universities
opportunities.description: Merit scholarship for students entering artificial intelligence and machine learning master's programs in Ontario, Canada.

opportunities.name: Master of Science in Applied Computing (AI Concentration)
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Tuition about $60,000 CAD for international students
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Bachelor's in computer science or related field with strong grades
opportunities.description: Professional master's in applied computing with artificial intelligence, machine learning and healthcare data concentrations and an industry internship.

opportunities.name: Chevening Scholarship
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full funding for a one-year UK master's
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree holders with 2 years of work experience from eligible countries
opportunities.description: Fully funded one-year master's in any subject at any UK university for future leaders.

opportunities.name: MSc Machine Learning
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Tuition about $50,000 for international students
opportunities.eligibility_summary: First-class or strong upper second-class degree in a quantitative subject
opportunities.description: Intensive one-year master's in machine learning, statistics and artificial intelligence with a research project.

opportunities.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarship
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full funding: tuition, stipend, airfare
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries who cannot afford UK study
opportunities.description: Fully funded master's in development-relevant fields including healthcare, engineering, science and technology.

opportunities.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarship
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full funding: tuition, monthly allowance, travel
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree holders, open to all nationalities
opportunities.description: Fully funded joint master's degrees across European universities in data science, artificial intelligence, public health, environment and more.

opportunities.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
opportunities.deadline: Varies by country, often February to October
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full funding for graduate study in the U.S.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Graduate students and young professionals from outside the U.S.
opportunities.description: Fellowship for master's or PhD study and research in the United States in any field.

opportunities.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full funding: tuition, housing, stipend, mentoring
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academically talented young people from Africa with financial need
opportunities.description: Comprehensive scholarships for undergraduate and master's study at partner universities, focused on leadership and social impact.

opportunities.name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full tuition, books, incidentals and residence for four years
opportunities.eligibility_summary: International high school students in their final year with outstanding achievement
opportunities.description: Undergraduate scholarship for exceptional international students showing leadership and academic excellence in any field including science and engineering.

opportunities.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship (Undergraduate)
opportunities.deadline: Typically May to June via embassies
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full tuition, monthly stipend, airfare
opportunities.eligibility_summary: High school graduates under 25, including a year of Japanese language study
opportunities.description: Funds undergraduate study in Japan in science, engineering, economics and humanities.

opportunities.name: Australia Awards Scholarship
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Full funding: tuition, travel, living allowance
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Citizens of participating developing countries
opportunities.description: Funds master's study in Australia in priority development areas such as public health, education, environment and governance.

opportunities.name: Master of Public Health (Online/Part-Time)
opportunities.provider: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Tuition about $85,000 total
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree, health-related experience preferred
opportunities.description: Part-time public health master's covering epidemiology, biostatistics, health policy and global health, mostly online.

opportunities.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery (MBBCh)
opportunities.deadline: Through national admissions after secondary exams
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Low public tuition for Egyptian citizens
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Secondary school graduates with top science scores

opportunities.name: AUC Undergraduate Merit Scholarship
opportunities.cost_or_funding: Partial to full tuition coverage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: High school students with outstanding grades and leadership
opportunities.description: Merit and need-based scholarships for undergraduate study in science, engineering, business and the humanities.

opportunities.name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate

opportunities.eligibility_summary: No prior experience required

opportunities.name: AI for Medicine Specialization

opportunities.cost_or_funding: Free to audit

opportunities.name: OpenWHO Public Health Courses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to everyone
opportunities.description: Free online courses on public health, epidemiology, health emergencies and healthcare for people helping their communities.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree holders aged 18-28 with leadership potential
opportunities.description: Fully funded one-year master's in global affairs, business, public policy and technology leadership.

opportunities.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
